exposure: reasons for obstetric referral to a tertiary care centre
cohort: 50 obstetric patients referred to a tertiary care centre in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India, were included in the study.
finding: The commonest risk factors for ICU admission were hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and obstetric haemorrhage, which also contributed significantly to maternal mortality.
mod_finding: A majority of the referred patients delivered by cesarean section (74%), with indications including Severe Pre-eclampsia, CPD, malposition, and eclampsia.
cross-section timing: Observations were collected over a duration of two years.
